$comment: MCP servers for this repository. See docs/MCP.md for the full rationale.
Deliberately small -- three servers, roughly 40-60 tools. Every server's
tools occupy context in every request, and overlapping servers measurably
degrade agent results. Adding 'everything available' is the common mistake.
IMPORTANT -- the azure server inherits your `az login` session, which on
this subscription is Owner. There is no blanket read-only flag, so the
namespace list below is the control: it loads only the tool groups needed
to READ platform state (groups, storage, monitor, kusto). Provisioning goes
through Terraform and a reviewed plan, never through a tool call -- see
@azure/mcp is beta (3.0.0-beta.x). Pinned to the beta line knowingly; treat
its output as advisory and verify anything surprising with `az` directly.
terraform and kubernetes servers touch no Azure control plane: terraform is
registry/docs lookup only, kubernetes talks to whatever kubeconfig context
is current -- which is why it is pinned read-only below.
